item.title: ElementsKit Elementor Addons Authenticated Stored XSS via REST API (CVE-2026-2600)

CVE / Advisory CVE-2026-2600
Category web
Severity Medium
CVSS Score 6.4 (MEDIUM)
Status Weaponized
Tags wordpress, elementor, stored-xss, rest-api, privilege-escalation, contributor, plugin, cwe-79
Related N/A

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System ElementsKit Elementor Addons (WordPress plugin)
Versions Affected <= 3.7.9 (fixed in 3.8.0)
Language / Platform Python 3 (requests-based WordPress REST API client)
Authentication Required Yes (Contributor role or above, i.e. edit_posts capability)
Network Access Required Yes

Summary

CVE-2026-2600 is a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the ElementsKit Elementor Addons plugin’s Simple Tab widget. The widget renders tab titles (ekit_tab_title) with echo and no output escaping in widgets/tab/tab.php. While Elementor’s page-builder UI sanitizes input on the client side, the WordPress REST API endpoint (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts/{id}) accepts the _elementor_data post meta field directly and bypasses that client-side layer entirely. As a result, any authenticated user with Contributor privileges (the minimum role that can create/edit posts) can PATCH a post’s _elementor_data with a crafted Elementor widget tree containing an XSS payload in ekit_tab_title, which then fires in every visitor’s browser — including administrators — once the post is published.

item.title: Spectra Gutenberg Blocks Authenticated Remote Code Execution — CVE-2026-7465
item.description:
Metadata

Field Value
Date Added 2026-07-05
Last Updated 2026-06
Author / Researcher izxci
CVE / Advisory CVE-2026-7465
Category web
Severity Critical
CVSS Score 8.8 (per source repository)
Status PoC
Tags wordpress, spectra, gutenberg, rce, arbitrary-function-call, uagb, contributor
Related N/A

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System Spectra (Gutenberg blocks plugin for WordPress, uagb/ block namespace)
Versions Affected Per source repository
Language / Platform Python 3 (exploit client) targeting a PHP/WordPress plugin
Authentication Required Yes — Contributor-level (or higher) WordPress account
Network Access Required Yes

Summary

The Spectra Gutenberg blocks plugin registers custom uagb/ block types whose rendering is driven by a render_callback value that can be influenced by attacker-controlled block content embedded in a post. An authenticated user with Contributor-level privileges can craft a two-block payload naming an arbitrary PHP function as the callback; when the post is rendered (e.g., via preview or on the frontend), WordPress invokes that PHP function, resulting in arbitrary PHP function execution ranging from information disclosure (phpinfo) to command execution (shell_exec, exec, system, passthru).
